widgets.text: Aero's drill attack (jump, then B diagonally/forward) damages enemies and bounces him off. Bungee cords, trapezes and cannons move him around the circus levels.
Bosses (Edgar Ektor's henchmen) take several drill hits; wait for the opening after their charge, hit once, back away. Keep throwing stars at airborne bosses.
Four worlds: the Circus, the Funpark, the Woods and Ektor's Museum, each several acts. Every act has a list of objectives (pass through hoops/stars, platforms) before the exit opens.
Each act lists its task on the top screen (for example 'pass through 20 stars' or 'jump on 5 platforms'). Hidden areas hold extra lives.
Clear every act's objectives to open its exit; the final fight is against Edgar Ektor in the museum.
